verdict.rationale: PostHog provides official SDKs across languages plus a documented REST API (capture events from any language via HTTP), an OpenAPI spec (posthog-probe-3), and official CLI/MCP tooling explicitly built for AI-native workflows (ship flags, run HogQL queries, debug stack traces from an editor/agent). Community evidence confirms real-world SDK integration success (Swift iOS) despite some rough edges in unrelated LLM chat UI features.
